# x-twitter-scraper_monitor_post (Resource)

Watches 1 post's replies, quotes, counts, edits & deletion



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `post` (String) Post link or ID. x.com, twitter.com, mobile & /i/web/status/ links work with any query string.

### Optional

- `event_types` (List of String) Post event types to send. Without it, a monitor sends new replies, new quotes, like & retweet changes, edits & deletion.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) Your own label for the post monitor. Its events carry it as monitorName.

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Permanent X user ID of the post's author.
- `author_name` (String)
- `author_username` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `next_billing_at` (String) Next hourly credit charge time for this post monitor.
- `paused_at` (String) When Xquik paused this post monitor.
- `paused_reason` (String) Why Xquik paused this post monitor, such as insufficient_credits or x_post_deleted.
- `post_id` (String) ID of the post you gave.
- `post_url` (String)
- `posted_at` (String)
- `text` (String) Text of the newest version Xquik read.
